items.quote: Den Nachzahlungsbetrag überweisen Sie bitte bis zum 15.12.2026 auf unser Konto.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for payment: 'bis zum 15.12.2026'. No period to count - the due date is printed directly. 2026-12-15 is a Tuesday (counting forward 21 days / 3 weeks from Tuesday 2026-11-24, the weekday is unchanged), so no weekend/holiday shift under §193 BGB is needed.

warnings: This is a private landlord/property-management invoice (not an authority), so the statutory deemed-delivery and Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung rules for administrative letters do not apply; the hand-delivery on 19.11.2026 at 10:20 is stated directly and used as the document/delivery date.

The IBAN DE61 6805 0101 0005 5133 00 is well-formed (checksum and length valid, BLZ 68050101), but this only confirms the IBAN's format, not that the account truly belongs to Hausverwaltung Exempeldreisam; compare it with earlier statements or the management's known bank details before paying.

German tenancy law (§556 Abs. 3 BGB) generally allows the tenant to raise objections to a Betriebskostenabrechnung within 12 months of receiving it (i.e. roughly by 19.11.2027), even though the letter itself states no such remedy or deadline for objections.
